response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-like SQL databases, along with strong architecture and open-source contributions, but his seniority level (Staff/Senior roles for over a decade) vastly exceeds the entry-level requirement, and his German language skills are only basic despite high on-site presence being required.
strengths: Extensive TypeScript and React experience across multiple production systems
Proven full-stack ownership from database to UI with clean architecture focus
Strong open-source contributions and DevOps/CI/CD infrastructure experience
concerns: Overqualified with 10+ years of senior/staff experience for an entry-level role
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site presence requirement
Focus on DLang and niche tools may indicate misalignment with stack priorities
